name: llm-judge-check
description: Checks an LLM-as-judge against human labels (agreement, Cohen's kappa, where the judge is wrong) and red-teams it (prompt injection, hallucination, refusals)

scripts.check: node src/build-cases.ts --check && node src/report.ts --check && node src/redteam.ts build --check && node src/redteam-report.ts --check && node src/eval.ts
